title: Every Token Needs Its Own Teacher: Multi-teacher Adaptive On-policy Self-distillation
snippet: Experiments with Qwen3 models on mathematical reasoning tasks show that MTA-OPSD consistently outperforms existing OPSD approaches with an average gain of up to $+5.9$ over the base model, highlighting the importance of adapting teacher supervision at the token level.
